_about: The caches that lie on a battle's field (the bible's loot rows: wrecks and alien remains, the rarest a chance at a blueprint, claimed by ending a move on one, a tap showing its kind and likely contents, never the contents). Ryan, 7 November: "have all the loot on the field round 1, and anything that is flattened, or gets flattened, gets 'upgraded.' So fetch lesser loot while it's safe, or fetch better loot later at greater risk. No need to worry about a stall issue because we just don't seed loot that close to the wall." Three kinds, one a tier from 1, their names working names (the bible's open row on the loot's names and density). per_battle caches are seeded with the map, one in each of as many bands along the wall, each kind by its weight, in the rows from rift_gap to wall_gap short of the gate's apron; a cache the seam has passed (a row nearer the rift than the seam's) stands one kind up, the top kind staying the top. Each holds salvage [lo, hi], so many components of the battle's tier, and a blueprint chance at a component of that tier the run holds no blueprint for. Shown: name, and codex (empty until Ryan writes one; a tap's readout says the likely contents from the numbers). Every number a placeholder.
